text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dura-san, thank you for the birthday 
present! I was so, so happy to get it!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Still, I was so surprised...! It's packed 
with towels, sports drinks, and even an 
assortment of nutrition bars!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I simply put in what was necessary. ...You 
have a tendency to push yourself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes rest is necessary too. ...Though 
I say that to remind myself as well.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you're right. A breather, huh... 
Ah, in that case!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
This might actually be perfect. Dura-san, 
would you mind coming with me for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
All our friends are throwing a birthday 
party! I'd really love it if you'd come 
celebrate with us!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
To catch my breath... you mean? While I 
appreciate the offer—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Please! Eating and chatting together would 
be the best way to refresh, I think.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Let's relax to our hearts' content and 
recharge for tomorrow! Right, Dura-san!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...Heh, fair enough. I was just 
reflecting on myself at an opportune 
moment anyway."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Aha, it's settled then! Let's get going 
right away!
